questions.question: When Jesus visited the home of Martha and her sister Mary, what did Mary do?

answers.text: Sat at His feet listening to Him
Brought Him a bowl of fresh water
Asked Him to bless the whole house

questions.question: When Martha came to Jesus in her home, what did she ask if He did not care about?

answers.text: Her sister leaving her to serve alone
The house being too small for everyone

questions.question: When Jesus spoke to Martha about what really matters, how many things did He say are necessary?
When Jesus visited Martha and Mary, He said Mary had chosen the good portion. What did He say about it?

answers.text: It will not be taken away from her
She has to set it aside for now
She can have it once the work is done
